text: hm. i dont see any highlights but the shape looks right
resolution: Fixed the missing hover highlights in triangle_mask_demo. Root cause: a Pressable's onMouseMove only fires while a mouse button is HELD (engine.zig gates dispatchPointerHandler(.move) on dragging_left), so a free-moving cursor delivered no events and the mouse state never became 'inside' — the shader's highlight branch was therefore never triggered (the forced-hover shot had already proven the shader itself was correct). Switched the input to poll the host's live cursor via getMouseX/getMouseY on a 33ms interval, converting screen coords to the surface's uv through the onLayout rect, and only setState on change to limit churn — the same pattern PaintCanvas uses for its hover ring. Removed the now-unused Pressable wrapper (plain Box with onLayout). Rebuilt clean.
